# Tutorials

Learning-oriented, end-to-end walkthroughs. Each tutorial takes you through a
complete, runnable fit and explains what each step does. If you are new to
gigalens, work through **Your first fit** first.

```{toctree}
:maxdepth: 1

first-fit
multiband
cosmology
shapelets
point-source
```

- **{doc}`first-fit`** — a complete single-plane fit, start to finish.
- **{doc}`multiband`** — one model, several imaging datasets.
- **{doc}`cosmology`** — sampling cosmological parameters and an unknown redshift.
- **{doc}`shapelets`** — flexible source light with least-squares amplitudes.
- **{doc}`point-source`** — image positions, fluxes, and time-delay `H0` (advanced).

For multi-lens-plane (line-of-sight) construction, see the how-to
{doc}`../how-to/multiplane`.
